verses.1: What is it that God has forgotten to gather together? You will be turned into a wild animal, and your flesh will become like that of a wild goat.
verses.2: I remember your assembly. I bought land for you long ago, so that you could have your own territory here in Mount Zion. This is the place where you live now.
verses.3: May your hands be raised for eternal blessings, against all evil and harm on the Sabbath day.
verses.4: Your enemies cried out in pain at the time of your death. They placed their hands on themselves.
verses.5: Let it be known that it brings up to the surface those who are like branches of a tree.
verses.6: And now, her gates shall be opened together, in Kashil and Kilafot Yahalomon.
verses.7: Send fire from your holy place to the land of desolation. Destroy the dwelling place of your name.
verses.8: They said in their hearts, “Let us burn down all the places where idols are worshipped on this earth.”
verses.9: We have not yet seen any prophet. Nor do we know who he is.
verses.10: Until death, God will protect His name from being profaned or maligned forever.
verses.11: Why do your hands and right hand rest near your vineyard?
verses.12: May the Lord, my King, act to save us from this situation near the earth.
verses.13: You have broken the sea with your arrogance. You have caused the heads of fish to be turned upside down on the water.
verses.14: You have risen above the heads of those who are weak and helpless. Please give us food for the people, so that they can live.
verses.15: You have been separated from the mountains and rivers. You are now alone, with nothing but deserts around you.
verses.16: You have day, and you also have night. You prepare light and the sun.
verses.17: You have set all the boundaries of the earth in chaos and disorder. You created them in such a way that they are in a state of chaos and disorder.
verses.18: Remember this, and may Jehovah be angered; may the wicked people be pursued by your name.
verses.19: Do not give life to those who are poor and needy. Do not forget about us forever.
verses.20: Look at the covenant; it is filled with the treasures of the earth.
verses.21: May those who are poor and humble dwell in peace, and may they praise your name.
verses.22: God has risen from your defeat. Remember your humiliation from before me, O enemy of all days.
verses.23: Do not forget the voice that calls you from afar, always urging you to rise up.
